name: usa-war-atlas
description: Atlas pédagogique et sourcé des guerres, interventions et acquisitions territoriales des États-Unis.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @usa-war-atlas/api" "npm run dev -w @usa-war-atlas/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @usa-war-atlas/shared && npm run build -w @usa-war-atlas/api && npm run build -w @usa-war-atlas/web
scripts.build:forge: npm run build -w @usa-war-atlas/shared && VITE_BASE=/atlas-embed/ VITE_API_URL=/atlas-embed npm run build -w @usa-war-atlas/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @usa-war-atlas/api && npm run lint -w @usa-war-atlas/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @usa-war-atlas/shared --if-present && npm run test -w @usa-war-atlas/api
